name: add_terminale_cd_coefficients_and_optional_lv2
query: ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_optional boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; INSERT INTO public.course_subject_offerings(subject_id,level_id,series_id,is_published,is_test_data,display_order) SELECT sub.id,l.id,sr.id,false,false,999 FROM public.subjects sub CROSS JOIN public.levels l CROSS JOIN public.series sr WHERE sub.name='Conduite' AND l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.course_subject_offerings o WHERE o.subject_id=sub.id AND offering_id FROM supplied JOIN public.levels l ON l.name=supplied.level_name JOIN public.series sr ON sr.name=supplied.series_name JOIN public.subjects sub ON sub.name=supplied.subject_name JOIN
